openQuestions.question: UnionPay appears in Table 1 (page 6) and Table 2 (page 10) but is absent from the Introduction's 15 card-type list on page 4. Confirm whether the Introduction is stale or UnionPay is intentionally out of this document's stated scope.
UnionPay's Card Type ID is printed as 'DS', identical to Discover Network's Card Type ID in the same table. Confirm whether this is a transcription error or an intentional shared code.
Fleetwide and Fuelman share the Card Type ID 'GF'. Confirm whether this is an intentional shared sponsor code or requires disambiguation for routing.
Diners Club mixes two PAN lengths (14 and 16) under a single IIN Length of 4. Confirm whether downstream validation must branch on PAN length.

ATL105 Element 2 refers credit, debit and EBT cards to this manual while referring fleet cards to the Petroleum Industry Processing Specification. Confirm whether the MasterCard Fleet, Visa Fleet, Voyager, WEX, Fleet One and Fuelman rows in this manual remain authoritative for IIN/PAN validation or are superseded by the Petroleum specification for those programs.
Debit and EBT declare IIN Length 0 and PAN Length 0 with a full 0..9 placeholder range. Confirm the intended meaning before treating these as validation-ready rules.
